name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Your tone is completely different from a moment ago.」

name: Ria
message: 「--Now then! This tutorial section is here to help you fully enjoy the battles in Kuru☆Kuru!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you suddenly talk about battle, I'm really not sure what I'm supposed to do...」

name: Ria
message: 「Experience is the best teacher. Just give everything a try first!\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, first... take a look at the battle screen.」

name: Ria
message: 「This is HP, which is basically the health of both enemies and allies.」

name: Ria
message: 「When you deal or take damage, HP decreases.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean we win if we bring the enemy's HP down to zero?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yup! Exactly!」

name: Ria
message: 「On the other hand, if our ally HP hits zero, it's Game Over, so be careful.」

name: Ria
message: 「And this over here is called the STUN Gauge, which also decreases when you attack.」

name: Synn
message: 「What happens when these stars run out?」

name: Ria
message: 「You get stunned and can't move for a while.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh! That sounds like a great chance for us!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. But only 'the character who gets attacked when the STUN Gauge hits zero' will be stunned, so keep that in mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So even if our allies' STUN Gauge hits zero, Ria-senpai and I won't be stunned at the same time, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. But attacking isn't the only way to stun an opponent.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?!」

name: Ria
message: 「We'll get to that in due time, though--」

name: Ria
message: 「Next, could you take a look at this?」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it...?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's called the EX Gauge... but I'll save the details on this for later, too♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't keep me in suspense like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Tee-hee, isn't being kept in suspense half the fun?」

name: Ria
message: 「Next up is this. Take a look at the 'Timeline', which shows you the whole battle situation at a glance in Kuru☆Kuru.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? There are icons for you and me, Ria-senpai. Oh, and one for the Demon, too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Those icons are called 'Symbols', and they represent where each character is.」

name: Ria
message: 「When battle starts, these Symbols will start moving towards the left.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... this 'ACT' spot looks like the end of the line.」

name: Ria
message: 「Once a Symbol reaches ACT, that character finally gets to take their turn!」

name: Ria
message: 「When their action finishes, they go back to the right. Then they start moving towards ACT all over again.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... so this screen itself acts like a timeline, then.」

name: Ria
message: 「Bingo!」

name: Synn
message: 「So the speed at which we move left is the same for both allies and enemies.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's why looking at this screen lets you know who gets to attack first.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, since we've reached ACT, let's actually try doing something!」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm... there's 'Attack' and 'Chant'. There's one more grayed-out button, but I take it that's a secret for now?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep, exactly. Let's learn the basic actions first\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「So 'Attack'... literally means attacking with those Spirit Arts things?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. See the element icon right here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. It says Darkness here.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's where you perform a Spirit Art attack corresponding to that element. So in your case, Synn, your element is Darkness.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, I see. Basically the standard 'Attack' command, right?」

name: Synn

name: Ria
message: 「That's not a clone. It's showing a guide previewing where you'll end up when your turn finishes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I get it... In short, 'Once my turn ends, I'll return to this spot.'」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep. And when you select 'Attack', next you choose your target.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's only one enemy right now, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, there won't always be just one enemy, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? As I was selecting the target, another enemy appeared!? Did it call for backup!?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not reinforcements,\s02 that's a guide showing how far back the enemy will be pushed when you land the attack.」

name: Synn
message: 「Pushed back...? You mean when someone gets hit, they get pushed further away from ACT?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. Which means they'll naturally get fewer chances to attack.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now when I try to select Chant... Whoa! I cloned myself again!」

name: Ria
message: 「Like... I... said,\s02 it's not a clone, it's a guide!」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it guiding this time?」

name: Ria
message: 「Chanting builds up Spirit Power to power you up.」

name: Ria
message: 「You see where it says Attack LV right here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Ria
message: 「This shows a general measure of our Spirit Power. The higher the LV, the more damage you deal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oho~~ So chanting raises this Attack LV, then.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep! Smart boy♪ But chanting takes a little bit of time to complete.」

name: Synn
message: 「So this guide is showing... how much time it's going to take.」

name: Ria
message: 「Bingo. Plus, you're completely defenseless while chanting, so if you get hit, you'll be in big trouble!」

name: Ria
message: 「Your chanting gets canceled, and you get pushed back even further than usual.」

name: Synn
message: 「So power comes with a price, huh?」

name: Ria

name: Synn

name: Ria

name: Ria
